source:
🎮 Complete Game Design & Concept Prompt
Core Style & Visuals:
Graphics Quality: AAA High-End Graphics, Ultra-Realistic 4K textures, dynamic lighting, cinematic visuals.
Environment & Atmosphere: Perpetual night setting. A dynamic 4K night sky featuring a large, glowing pale-blue moon (instead of white) casting subtle light onto castles and small houses. Volumetric dark clouds and lightweight atmospheric fog covering the map.
Terrain: Extremely uneven and distorted terrain with rolling hills, valleys, small mountains, and deep gorges. The ground is covered with rich, highly-detailed, moving/swaying realistic dynamic grass.
🏰 World & Map Structure
Map Size: Massive, seamless open-world map.
Castles (10-11 Castles):
Massive scale, dark gothic style, breathtaking architecture.
Situated far apart from each other across the map.
Interiors: Complex layout containing rustic wooden rooms, old wooden furniture (slightly aged/weathered, not overly clean), fully furnished kitchens, medieval bathrooms, and secret chambers.
Small Houses & Looting:
Small scattered houses across the wild terrain.
Loot System: Treasure chests containing in-game currency (e.g., small houses hold around 20 coins, while major zones hold high-tier riches).
👾 Monsters & Enemies (AI Bosses)
Design: Tall, extremely terrifying wizard-like creatures with long noses and dark robes.
Behavior: Highly aggressive AI guarding high-value chest areas. They detect nearby players instantly and pursue them to kill.
Stats & Difficulty: Extremely overpowered (Boss level). Standard punch/unarmed attacks deal virtually zero damage to them, requiring high-tier weapons and strategy to defeat.
⚔️ Combat, Weapons & Economy
PVP & Multiplayer:
Full Open-World Free-For-All PVP enabled. Players can attack and kill any other player anywhere on the map.
Custom lobby/host settings to toggle PVP on or off for joining players.
Combat System:
Melee-focused combat with a knife/dagger progression system.
Upgrading to higher-tier knives increases damage drastically against both players and monsters.
PVP Balance: A standard precise hit with a basic/default knife takes around 10 direct hits (10 damage instances) to eliminate an enemy player.
Shops & Vendors:
Small, beautiful, illuminated shop huts glowing warm light into the dark night.
Full Buy/Sell system allowing players to purchase upgraded knives, items, and sell looted treasures/items.
🐎 Travel & Exploration
Mounts: Rideable horses for fast travel across the vast terrain and valleys.

answers.ask: How far apart should the castles be — a few minutes ride, or long enough that horses are essential?
answers.answer: Place castles far enough apart that horses are essential for practical travel between them; crossing on foot should take a long time.

answers.ask: Must the world be genuinely seamless, or is it acceptable for castle interiors and outlying regions to load as separate zones?
answers.answer: The main world should be genuinely seamless as specified, but castle interiors may load as separate zones to keep the build practical.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] scale — Q: How far apart should the castles be — a few minutes ride, or long enough that horses are essential? A: Place castles far enough apart that horses are essential for practical travel between them; crossing on foot should take a long time.
- [author] shape — Q: Must the world be genuinely seamless, or is it acceptable for castle interiors and outlying regions to load as separate zones? A: The main world should be genuinely seamless as specified, but castle interiors may load as separate zones to keep the build practical.
- [agent_inferred] castle_count — Q: Should the 10-11 castle range be fixed for this artifact? A: Preserve the requested range and build 10–11 castle sites, with one separate interior map per castle.

## Enriched image prompt
Create a massive seamless dark-fantasy overworld at perpetual night, with 10–11 enormous gothic castles spaced so far apart that horse travel is essential. Shape the land with extreme rolling hills, valleys, small mountains, and deep gorges under detailed swaying grass. Scatter small lootable houses and warm illuminated shop huts through the wilderness. Give each castle a distinct distant silhouette beneath a huge pale-blue glowing moon, dark volumetric clouds, and light atmospheric fog. Reserve high-value chest grounds around castles for terrifying boss encounters and place lower-value treasure sites inside scattered houses.

Treat each castle interior as a separate linked map. Build complex rustic wooden room networks with aged furniture, fully furnished kitchens, medieval bathrooms, and secret chambers containing major treasure areas. Keep the overworld itself continuous and richly landscaped, with readable routes around gorges and horse staging ground near major destinations.

## Genre
The dominant genre is RPG, with Action secondary because melee combat and boss encounters materially shape destination grounds.

## Shape and preset
Use `world-hub-dungeon`, Hub and Dungeons, adapting the seamless overworld as the shared hub feeding 10–11 separate castle-interior maps. The closest preset is Action RPG, with its safe-town and clustered-hub options removed because PvP and travel span the whole world.

## Config requirements
Use `terrain-relief` for hills, valleys, mountains, and gorges; `landmark-focal` for all 10–11 distant castles; `building-interior` for castle, house, and shop spaces; `hazard-aggro` for boss encounter grounds; the visible side of `collectible-nodes` for treasure-chest sites; and `npc-population` for rideable-horse staging ground. Add scattered warm shop huts as scene-specific image geometry because no catalogue option represents dispersed buy/sell vendors.

## Layout requirements
Place `spawner-npc` at each high-value castle treasure ground, separated from travel approaches. Place `collectible-nodes` as lower-value Collectible chest anchors in small houses and high-tier anchors in castle zones. Place `npc-population` as horse occupancy zones near shops and castle approaches.

## Layout components
There is one huge seamless overworld map plus 10–11 separate Castle Interior maps. The overworld contains 10–11 castle exteriors, extreme terrain, small houses, shop huts, treasure grounds, horse staging areas, and long connected travel corridors. Every castle portal links to its own furnished interior room network and secret chamber.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: make world routes, widely separated landmarks, gorge bypasses, and every exterior-to-interior link authoritative, then dress the moonlit isometric scenes.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
The overworld scale band is huge, while separate interiors preserve room-level detail. The theme is ultra-realistic gothic night under a pale-blue moon, fog, dark clouds, warm huts, and aged wood. Use `tiered` for severe relief, `P4` for 10–11 separate interior maps, and `P3` for exterior-to-interior transitions.
